title: R&D Tax Incentive replaces the R&D tax concession
summary: For income years starting on or after 1 July 2011 the R&D Tax Incentive replaced the concession, with a refundable offset for smaller companies.

instruments.title: Tax Laws Amendment (Research and Development) Act 2011

commenced.what: Incentive applies to income years from 1 July 2011

direction_rationale: A refundable offset for smaller, often loss-making firms lowers the cost of R&D for entrants and challengers.
comparison: Firms either side of the turnover threshold for the refundable offset (firm-level data)

verified.notes: Date from the ATO's transition guidance.
